prompt: Security issue in Portal `NamespaceController`. Two endpoints check permission for the appId in the URL path but act on the appId from the request body: creating namespaces (POST /apps/{appId}/namespaces, a list of namespace creation models) and creating app namespaces (POST /apps/{appId}/appnamespaces). A user can therefore create namespaces for another application. In both endpoints, reject the request with a `BadRequestException` when any payload appId differs from the path appId.

oracle_plan.instruction: Add a helper that throws BadRequestException when path and payload appId differ; call it for every model in createNamespace and for the AppNamespace in createAppNamespace, before any side effect.
